name: Suzuki Intruder 1500 LC / Boulevard C90
engine: 1462 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, carbs then fuel injection, shaft drive
intro: Suzuki's 1500 cruiser. 1998-2005 bikes and some 2006 bikes have a fuel tank recall that Suzuki said not to ride with.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. All 1998-2005 VL1500s and some 2006 VL1500 and C90 bikes are in recall 06V025 for a fuel tank that can seep fuel.
A-002.reason: Seeping fuel is a fire risk. Suzuki said not to ride an affected bike until it is fixed. The fix is free.

G: Check which you have. Carbureted bikes get the carb steps; fuel-injected bikes skip them.

recalls.what: Fuel tank can seep fuel, which is a fire risk.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects and replaces the fuel tank free.
